item.title: Hannah Peel's Mary Casio makes a return journey - Real World Records
item.description: Hannah Peel’s third album, ‘Mary Casio: Journey to Cassiopeia’ - a seven-movement odyssey composed for analogue synthesizers and traditional 29-piece colliery brass band - explores one person's journey to outer space, by recounting the story of an unknown, elderly, pioneering, electronic musical stargazer and her lifelong dream to leave her terraced home in the mining town of Barnsley, South Yorkshire, to see Cassiopeia for herself.

item.title: Clara Serra López new EP for Real World X - Real World Records
item.description: On Lengua Materna (Part II), Clara Serra López continues the story from her first EP. Shifting focus toward the isolation and mistrust produced by today’s social systems whilst seeking to rebuild connection within our communities to make the struggle survivable, and shared.

item.title: Hannah Peel & Beibei Wang - new collaboration - Real World Records
item.description: Hannah Peel & Beibei Wang have announced details of their debut album together, The Endless Dance, out on blue vinyl, a Dinked orange marble edition, CD and digitally on 22 May 2026 via Real World, and shared news of a live performance of the album on 24 October 2026 at the Barbican, London.

item.title: Guernica Jigsaw - new music from L.Y.R. - Real World Records
item.description: Following the singles Blah! Blah! Blah! and Dark Sky Reservation, today L.Y.R. share captivating LP highlight Guernica Jigsaw, a tale of unrequited love set in the over-commercialised world of contemporary art. Two employees who work in the modern retail sector keep failing to connect, dwarfed and disillusioned by municipal culture, or simply too cool to break out of their allotted roles.
